entry.focal: A single orange hotspot on the glass wall at about x 81. The rest of the wall is dull brown. The white rail-post lanterns are brighter than the lava.
entry.next_visible: n/a (terminal space). The return route to the tunnel is behind.

reveal.focal: The long receding glass wall with its hotspot, the lantern posts and the benches. The perspective is good, but the east end fades to black.

concept.focal: Square-on: one bright orange patch with a lumpy blob on the ceiling above it, and a bench in the foreground. There are no bays or mullions.

strip.focal: Frames 0-3 are warm. Frames 4-7 (x 90-118) are almost black, with the wall barely visible.

fixes.detail: The magma_glass_wall is lit by one spot at x≈81 instead of being emissive along its whole 82 m length. Make each 7.5 m bay emissive (varied intensity, with dark bronze mullions between) so the whole wall is the key light and the strip's east half is not black.
11 lantern_post (1.7 m white slabs) at an even 7.5 m on the rail are brighter than the lava; dim 0.3 is not taking effect. Use 0.6-0.8 m rail-post lights, actually dimmed.
The 53 railing pieces at y 9.3 are not visible in any view. Check that they are built (h 1.0 rail in front of the glass). They give the foreground layer in concept 23 and 36.

An unexplained draped mesh hangs under the ceiling at about (81,8), above the hotspot, with a dark mound at the wall foot below it (visible in the concept and reveal views). Identify it and remove it, or hide it in the vault.
13 rock_cluster on the north wall are fine. Add 2-3 at the far east end (x 112-121) with a warm floor pool, so the end of the walk is not a black void.

top_change: Make the entire 82 m glass wall emissive bay by bay so it is unmistakably the brightest thing and lights the whole hall, then dim the rail-post lanterns below it.
plausibility: An odd blob or emitter under the ceiling sits above the hotspot.
The railing is missing or invisible.
